# Baloo

> Baloo is a self-hosted AI code review GitHub App for pull requests. It reviews diffs and repository context, posts GitHub-native review feedback, and supports Anthropic, Amazon Bedrock, Google, OpenAI, and Databricks model providers.

Baloo is intended for teams that want automated pull request review without installing a hosted code review SaaS. Operators deploy Baloo, configure a GitHub App, choose model credentials, and control repository installation scope.

Canonical website: https://www.bluebear.io

## Start Here

- [Project README](https://github.com/bluebear-io/baloo-bear/blob/main/README.md): Overview, features, quick start, use cases, and FAQ.
- [Getting Started](https://bluebear-io.github.io/baloo-bear/getting-started/): End-to-end setup with Docker Compose, ngrok, and a GitHub App.
- [How to Get the Most Out of Baloo](https://bluebear-io.github.io/baloo-bear/how-to-get-the-most/): Repo conventions, per-PR review briefs, and workflows that produce high-signal reviews.
- [Configuration](https://bluebear-io.github.io/baloo-bear/configuration/): Environment variables, defaults, and deployment settings.

## Core Concepts

- [Review Agent](https://bluebear-io.github.io/baloo-bear/features/review-agent/): How Baloo performs agentic PR review.
- [Guidelines Enforcement](https://bluebear-io.github.io/baloo-bear/features/guidelines/): How Baloo reads `AGENTS.md` and `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
- [Model Configuration](https://bluebear-io.github.io/baloo-bear/features/models/): Supported providers (Anthropic, Amazon Bedrock, Google, OpenAI, Databricks), model tiers, and provider switching.
- [Amazon Bedrock Setup](https://bluebear-io.github.io/baloo-bear/features/bedrock/): Step-by-step guide to run Baloo on Amazon Bedrock, including auth methods and sandbox caveats.
- [Databricks Setup](https://bluebear-io.github.io/baloo-bear/features/databricks/): Step-by-step guide to run Baloo through a Databricks AI Gateway.
- [Severity Routing](https://bluebear-io.github.io/baloo-bear/features/severity-routing/): How findings map to review comments, Checks API annotations, and approval decisions.
- [Discussion Tracking](https://bluebear-io.github.io/baloo-bear/features/discussions/): How Baloo follows up on its earlier review threads across commits.

## Security and Operations

- [Security Policy](https://github.com/bluebear-io/baloo-bear/blob/main/SECURITY.md): Vulnerability reporting and disclosure expectations.
- [Docker Deployment Guide](https://github.com/bluebear-io/baloo-bear/blob/main/DOCKER.md): Container setup, private key options, and production notes.
- [Development](https://bluebear-io.github.io/baloo-bear/development/): Contributor commands, test workflow, and local development.

## Optional Features

- [False-Positive Verification](https://bluebear-io.github.io/baloo-bear/features/fp-verification/): Second-pass LLM verification of findings (on by default).
- [Fidelity Analysis](https://bluebear-io.github.io/baloo-bear/features/fidelity/): Comparing implementation against plan documents.
- [Documentation Drift](https://bluebear-io.github.io/baloo-bear/features/documentation-drift/): PR-time stale docs detection using a repo-owned catalog.
- [Dashboard](https://bluebear-io.github.io/baloo-bear/features/dashboard/): PostgreSQL-backed review history and cost tracking.
- [Thread Agent](https://bluebear-io.github.io/baloo-bear/features/thread-agent/): Replies when developers answer Baloo's inline comments (off by default).
